limits: Metrics apply only to declared crops and masks. They do not establish whole-app feature parity, keyboard behavior, accessibility, an undocumented DPI, or native dark/high-contrast behavior. Missing regions, different dimensions and mismatching enabled states fail rather than being silently resized or discarded.

unavailableComparisons.reason: An online native screenshot supplies semantic captions, but its apparent native scale differs from actual 96 DPI captures and the publisher did not record DPI. Strict same-DPI pixels need a matching source or an environment supporting that actual native DPI.

The authentic 552x245 screenshot proves one Open location control and simultaneous Shortcut/Application contextual tabs. Its 66px command band and smaller caption/tab glyphs do not establish actual 96DPI pixels; native DPI/build and original resize history are unspecified. The red arrow and selected-row outline are publisher annotations. Capture the actual owned executable .lnk but require a matching native-size source before strict pixel parity.
